items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: People like George Shearing picked it up later.

ctx.x: You know, you mentioned Teddy Buckner.

Well, Teddy Buckner, of course, was Milt's brother. Milt, I don't know whether you know this, originated that block chord style. He could do it faster than anyone I've ever heard in my life, you know? People like George Shearing picked it up later. I even tried to do it a few times but it's very difficult to do.
